verified: The supplied TechCrunch article reports that Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO and Google nearly 14%, for close to 30% combined.
unconfirmed: The precise stakes, the terms of Amazon's option to increase its holding, the IPO timing and valuation, and whether the figures come from an official filing; the supplied article provides no primary document or independent confirmation.

verified: TechCrunch 报道称，IPO 后亚马逊持股略低于 15%、谷歌接近 14%，亚马逊另有增持选择权。
unconfirmed: 上述比例来自“据报道”，Anthropic、亚马逊和谷歌均未公开确认；亚马逊可增持到何种上限、以什么条件增持、IPO 的具体时间与估值，以及这些股份对应的投票权安排，报道均未给出。

titles.en: Report: Amazon and Google to own nearly 30% of Anthropic after IPO
titles.zh: Anthropic IPO 后，亚马逊与谷歌合计持股将接近 30%
